notes: G3 spec (amount+1 on the search count, option 2). Printed: 'At the beginning of your upkeep, you may search your library and/or graveyard for A Shrine card and put it ONTO THE BATTLEFIELD.' The controller chooses to search your graveyard only, where two Shrines wait: Sanctum of Tranquil Light (copy A, the pick) and Sanctum of Stone Fangs (copy B; a different name, so the legend rule cannot hide a second find). Copy A enters; copy B stays in your graveyard.
